author: JstrJad
body: Hi, I'm JstrJad. I've been banned for flying. Now I did deserve the ban because I used to use an xray and fly mod, but since the ban I have gotten rid of any cheating mods. I will play by the rules and no longer cheat on my favorite server. Thank you.

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

You have only been banned for 1 day. You must be banned for a significant amount of time before you have any chance of being appealed. You will not be appealed now.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
